svg.text: Stamen = Filament + Anther · Pistil = Stigma + Style + Ovary

g.text: Petals are the colorful, large structures — pink in this flower.
Sepals are small green leaf-like parts beneath the petals.
Anther is golden/yellow; it sits on top of the filament.
Stigma is the sticky top; Style is the tube connecting it to the ovary.
Ovary contains ovules; Receptacle is the green base of the flower.
💡 Remember: Petals attract · Sepals protect · Stamens produce · Pistils receive
A complete flower has both male (stamen) and female (pistil) reproductive organs.
The sepals and petals together form the perianth, which protects the reproductive parts.
Compare your answers with the key above. How many did you get right?
Since this is a static SVG learning tool, simply review the diagram
again from scratch. Try to identify all 10 parts from memory!
Start with the largest structures (petals, sepals) then work inward.
Group related parts: Stamen = Filament + Anther | Pistil = Stigma + Style + Ovary
